rationale: Because Clarence Thomas is the most senior justice in the majority, he is likely to assign (and often keep) an opinion reaffirming Pennsylvania Fire and treating consent-by-registration as a distinct, waiver-based jurisdictional path not displaced by Daimler/Goodyear. Separate writings are likely to cluster around (i) limiting-principle/voluntariness concerns in dissent (especially Brett Kavanaugh, possibly joined by John Roberts) and (ii) concurrences flagging Commerce Clause or unconstitutional-conditions caveats (especially Neil Gorsuch and Samuel Alito).
